meta.title: Decennium Descent Gameplay Loop
meta.status: canonical rules; encounter budget numbers remain provisional pending V7.2 holdout calibration
meta.designRule: Decennium Descent should have 5e's readability and speed, Pathfinder 2e's tactical clarity and balance discipline, and its own expedition, extraction, Haven, and seasonal systems.
meta.publicDepthBoundary: The most famous recognized expedition failed at the Sixth Gate; deeper truth remains Director-only.
meta.evidenceNote: V7.2 applies high-confidence procedural findings from the V7.1 AI Lab. Global class and encounter-number changes require deterministic holdout evidence.

resolution.formula: d20 + ability modifier + proficiency when trained + circumstance modifiers

abortSuccess.definition: A declared withdrawal is successful when the Expedition reaches the Haven or surface before the charter's maximum casualties, minimum reserve Supply, latest return hour, or other recorded withdrawal limits are violated.
abortSuccess.relationshipToObjective: A successful withdrawal can still be a failed primary objective. Record survival, objective completion, and profitability separately.

forcedMarchUnknown.availability: Only when Mapping is Unknown and the Expedition cannot or will not wait for Map Route.
forcedMarchUnknown.supplyCost: Consume one additional Supply per active character.
forcedMarchUnknown.check: Routekeeper makes a Severe route check before movement.
forcedMarchUnknown.failure: No Progress and resolve a Standard complication.
forcedMarchUnknown.criticalFailure: No Progress and resolve a Severe complication.
forcedMarchUnknown.purpose: Prevents procedural deadlock while preserving Reconnaissance as the safer and more efficient choice.

pressure.check: At end of active Watch roll 1d6; complication occurs when roll <= Pressure; Pressure 6 is automatic severe.
pressure.attentionCadence: Add +1 when Attention cargo is first carried exposed into an active Watch, re-exposed, or loses concealment; do not add again each Watch during continuous controlled carriage.

restDebt.trigger: A character works during the Watch assigned as that character's Rest Watch, or an attempted Rest Watch is interrupted before completion.
restDebt.deadline: Complete one full Rest Watch before the end of the second following Watch.
restDebt.interruption: The two-Watch countdown begins after the interruption or emergency scene is resolved.
restDebt.failure: At the end of the second following Watch, gain 1 Strain. The Rest Debt remains until a full Rest Watch is completed.
restDebt.stacking: A character can owe only one Rest Debt at a time; another missed Rest while owing debt immediately causes 1 Strain and resets the countdown to two Watches.

cargo.loadUnit: approximately ten pounds or one awkward bundle
cargo.carryLimit: Strength score in Load; Small -2; Large double
cargo.burdenedEffect: Speed -10 and disadvantage climbing, swimming, and silent movement

actionLimits.additionalActionSlot: One shared additional full Action slot across all sources; effects do not stack and cannot retrigger themselves.
actionLimits.excessActors: one swarm, cohort, or unit stat block
actionLimits.dualCast: one Action; resolve two Tier 1-2 one-Action spells; pay both RP; only one may require concentration
actionLimits.traumaticCasting: cannot refund, reset, or retrigger itself; its direct trauma cannot be prevented by itself or the forced spell

retreat.roundThreat: Default to pursuit check plus one meaningful threat; full nova requires failed check, Severe complication, or trapped fiction.
retreat.clarification: A side can gain at most one Escape success in a round from either the lead check or winning the round, unless a feature explicitly grants an additional Escape success. Critical Success on the lead check still grants two Escape successes when the Director uses that outcome.

wounds.penalty: -1 Constitution saves and -1 healing per Hit Die

combat.tenacity: First full-turn control each round becomes Staggered; Gate Guardians may resist twice.

encounterMath.partySizeAdjustment: Use the explicit party-size multiplier table. Do not compound 20% adjustments exponentially.
encounterMath.status: canonical procedure; numeric budgets are provisional until V7.2 automated holdout calibration passes

difficultyAccounting.rule: The final listed encounter difficulty includes creature Threat Points plus all objective, terrain, surprise, and hazard adjustments. Apply each adjustment once and never double-step.
difficultyAccounting.worksheet: Choose a creature budget, identify non-creature complications, then label the final difficulty after adjustments.
difficultyAccounting.fullEnemyFreeRound: A full unopposed enemy round is two difficulty steps, not ordinary surprise.
difficultyAccounting.ordinarySurprise: Use hidden positioning, advantage, restricted reactions, or a one-step difficulty increase; it does not automatically grant a full unopposed enemy turn.

objectiveProfiles.defeatOrDriveOff: Use the creature budget as the primary difficulty measurement.
objectiveProfiles.protectCargo: Creature budget plus a one-step objective adjustment unless the final label already includes it. State cargo movement, Secure Cargo actions, and loss conditions before initiative.
objectiveProfiles.escort: Use a progress or survival clock with explicit escort HP, movement, and failure thresholds; do not infer difficulty from kill win rate alone.
objectiveProfiles.hazard: Build the hazard DC, cadence, and consequences separately, then include its one-step adjustment in the final encounter label.
objectiveProfiles.ambush: Ordinary surprise is one step. A full free enemy round is two steps and should be reserved for a failed reconnaissance state or severe complication.
objectiveProfiles.retreat: Use the three-Escape-before-three-Pursuit clock. Kill-budget win rate does not define retreat difficulty.

severe.intent: defeat likely without preparation or advantage

levelGuidance.1-2: Do not build Standard encounters from two creatures above party level. Prefer fewer equal-level or several lower-level threats until the calibration suite confirms a replacement budget.
levelGuidance.3-4: Use the published chassis as the initial reference and monitor resources and downed characters.
levelGuidance.5-16: The V7.1 proxy model found Standard and Hard labels too soft. Use objectives, phases, terrain, and calibrated creature fixtures rather than adding arbitrary HP.
levelGuidance.17-20: Composition and control resistance dominate outcomes. Require phase, objective, and party-composition tests before assigning a label.

extraction.test: d20 + Quartermaster Survival, vehicle, or relevant tool modifier + assistants vs tier DC + highest Extraction Class modifier + handling modifiers
extraction.failure: lose 8 hours and standard complication, or one low-priority lot at risk
extraction.criticalFailure: severe complication and two lots, a vehicle, or a casualty at risk

testCadence.Mapped: midpoint and exit if Length >= 6; otherwise exit

extraction.failureChoice: Players choose between the stated time/complication cost and the stated low-priority cargo risk after the Director identifies what is at risk.

saleValue.formula: Base Value × Provenance × Demand × Condition × Urgency

accessGates.-5: Proscribed: no legal access; detention or attack expected.
accessGates.-4: Hunted: no legal access; only covert contacts.
accessGates.-3: Hostile: black-market or enemy intermediaries only.
accessGates.-2: Distrusted: routine necessities at surcharge; no licenses, credit, or restricted auctions.
accessGates.-1: Unwelcome: routine public market only; no institutional privileges.
accessGates.0: Neutral: routine market, lodging, and ordinary contracts.
accessGates.1: Recognized: ordinary licenses and verified-buyer access.
accessGates.2: Favored: restricted-material desks and selected auctions.
accessGates.3: Trusted: institutional credit, bonded storage, and sensitive contracts.
accessGates.4: Champion: strategic auctions, command audiences, and major exemptions.
accessGates.5: Authority: may issue contracts, sponsor expeditions, and exercise institutional power.

advancement.awardPrinciple: all materially contributing Expedition members receive awards; combat body count is not privileged
advancement.detailedXp: optional; do not combine with milestone levels during the same advancement period

seasonal.mapPersistence: secured trunk principles persist; unsecured spurs, chambers, nodes, and local hazards reset or transform
seasonal.clarification: One dungeon Opening occurs in each ten-year Cycle. A single Opening may contain many expeditions, phases, contracts, and campaign seasons, but those are not additional Openings.

coinAssay.detectedCounterfeitForfeiture: Seize 100% of confirmed counterfeit coin or plated false currency. Legitimate metal or genuine coins in the same documented lot are returned after assay and remint fees.
coinAssay.fine: An innocent documented holder pays no criminal fine. A knowing holder pays the greater of 10% of the false lot face value or the assay and remint fees.

underwaysHeat.check: at end of active Haven Turn, 1d6 <= Heat creates enforcement complication

bribes.restriction: A bribe cannot be paid at Heat 0. The floor applies only when the operation had Heat 1 or higher before the bribe.

traffickingEvidence.completion: warrant, raid, public hearing, rescue operation, or faction confrontation

insurance.coveredLoss: Declared cargo lost through a recorded extraction complication, theft, transport failure, or insured hazard.
exclusions: voluntary abandonment outside an insured sacrifice clause
loss caused after a recorded abort condition was knowingly ignored
insurance.formula: Payout = insured value × provenance payout rate - deductible; payout cannot exceed insured value.

charterMetrics.netExpeditionTarget: after mandatory Haven costs and sponsor share
charterMetrics.trueProfitTarget: after wages, repairs, replacements, debt service, and reserve

havenShortPath.name: Tier I fast settlement
havenShortPath.useWhen: No disputed ownership, strategic cargo, active lien, quarantine crisis, contraband case, or faction hearing requires the full ten-step procedure.
havenShortPath.escalation: Move to the full Haven procedure when any skipped step becomes materially relevant.

quickstart.spokenLoop: Objective -> finance -> roster -> load -> Watches -> encounters -> cargo -> extraction -> Haven -> advancement -> Cycle Record
